obituaries.name: Dr. Tariq Mahmood Al-Hassan
obituaries.biography: Dr. Tariq Mahmood Al-Hassan passed away peacefully surrounded by his family. A beloved community leader, physician, and founding trustee of the Bridgeview Islamic Center. Over 40 years, he served as a compassionate cardiologist and mentored hundreds of young Muslim medical professionals.
obituaries.family: Survived by his wife Amina, four children, and nine grandchildren.

janazah.notes: Brothers and sisters are invited to attend. Wudu facilities available. Parking in north and south lots.

condolenceWindow.visitationAddress: Al-Hassan Family Residence, 9240 S Harlem Ave, Bridgeview, IL

sadaqah.title: Clean Water Solar Well in Rural Sindh
sadaqah.organization: Helping Hand for Relief and Development (HHRD)
sadaqah.description: Building a sustainable solar-powered deep water well providing clean drinking water to over 800 villagers in honor of Dr. Tariq Mahmood.

sadaqah.title: Quranic Library Endowment at Bridgeview Academy
sadaqah.description: Sponsoring Tajweed Qurans and Islamic reference texts for youth students.

obituaries.name: Hajja Mariam Bint Ibrahim Zaid
obituaries.biography: With heavy hearts, the Zaid and Kaddoura families announce the passing of Hajja Mariam. Known for her boundless hospitality, support for local refugees, and teaching Quran to neighborhood children for over three decades. May Allah expand her grave, fill it with light, and grant her Jannat al-Firdaus.
obituaries.family: Survived by her husband Sheikh Omar Zaid, son Kareem, and daughters Fatima and Huda.

janazah.mosque: Islamic Center of Passaic County (ICPC Paterson)
janazah.notes: Condolences will be held in the ICPC Community Center hall following the burial.

condolenceWindow.visitationAddress: ICPC Banquet Hall, 152 Derrom Ave, Paterson, NJ

sadaqah.title: Orphan Care & Education Sponsorship
sadaqah.description: Providing food, clothing, and schooling for 5 orphan children for two full years in memory of Hajja Mariam.

obituaries.name: Sayyid Ali Raza Al-Musawi
obituaries.biography: Sayyid Ali Raza Al-Musawi passed away after a valiant struggle with illness. He was an esteemed architect who designed community centers and advocated tirelessly for interfaith dialogue across Texas.
obituaries.family: Survived by his wife Zahra and sons Hassan and Hussein.

condolenceWindow.visitationAddress: IEC Houston Main Hall, 2313 S Voss Rd, Houston, TX

sadaqah.title: Clean Water Plant in East Africa
sadaqah.description: Establishing a solar water filtration station dedicated to Sayyid Ali Raza Al-Musawi.

obituaries.name: Ustadh Bilal Kareem Vance
obituaries.biography: Ustadh Bilal Vance returned to his Creator at age 49. A dedicated educator, youth mentor, and revert advocate who helped welcome hundreds of new Muslims to the faith in Greater Toronto.
obituaries.family: Survived by his wife Khadijah, son Tariq, and daughter Sumayya.

sadaqah.title: New Muslim Welcome & Education Fund
sadaqah.description: Sponsoring mentorship toolkits, English Quran translations, and educational courses for revert brothers and sisters.

obituaries.name: Hajjah Maryam Abdullah
obituaries.biography: A beloved mother, grandmother, and longtime teacher of the community Sunday school. She was known for her open door, her Qur'an circle, and the soup she brought to every family in hardship. May Allah have mercy on her and grant her Jannat al-Firdaws.
obituaries.family: Survived by her children Fatima, Yusuf, and Bilal, and nine grandchildren.

janazah.notes: Parking in the rear lot. Ghusl completed at the mosque.

sadaqah.title: Solar water well in her name
sadaqah.description: A solar-powered water well established as Sadaqah Jariyah in her name.

obituaries.name: Sheikh Abdul Aziz ibn Baz
obituaries.biography: Grand Mufti of Saudi Arabia from 1993 until his passing, and former head of the Council of Senior Scholars. Among the most influential Sunni scholars of the 20th century, he authored numerous works on fiqh, aqidah, and the Sunnah.

obituaries.name: Sheikh Muhammad Nasiruddin al-Albani
obituaries.biography: Albanian-born hadith scholar (muhaddith) renowned for his authentication work on the hadith collections, including the Silsilat al-Ahadith al-Sahihah and his abridgement and grading of major works.

obituaries.name: Sheikh Muhammad ibn Salih al-Uthaymeen
obituaries.biography: Saudi scholar, teacher at the Grand Mosque in Makkah, and member of the Council of Senior Scholars. Widely known for his Qur'an exegesis, fiqh works, and decades of lessons broadcast across the Muslim world.

obituaries.name: Sheikh Muqbil ibn Hadi al-Wadi'i
obituaries.biography: Yemeni hadith scholar who founded the Dar al-Hadith institute in Dammaj, Yemen, which became a major centre for students of hadith from around the world.

obituaries.name: Sheikh Wahbah al-Zuhayli
obituaries.biography: Syrian professor of Islamic jurisprudence at Damascus University and author of the comparative fiqh encyclopedia Al-Fiqh al-Islami wa Adillatuhu (Islamic Jurisprudence and Its Proofs).

obituaries.name: Sheikh Saleh ibn Muhammad al-Luhaydan
obituaries.biography: Saudi judge and scholar, long-serving head of the Supreme Judicial Council and member of the Council of Senior Scholars and the Muslim World League's Fiqh Academy.

obituaries.name: Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi
obituaries.biography: Egyptian-born scholar based in Qatar, chairman of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, and author of over a hundred books including Al-Halal wa al-Haram (The Lawful and the Prohibited) and Fiqh al-Zakat.

condolences.author: Dr. Sameer Siddiqui
condolences.message: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Dr. Tariq was a giant of humility and medical skill. He was my mentor during residency at Rush Medical Center. May Allah grant him the company of the Prophets and the Righteous in Firdous.
condolences.arabicDua: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ

condolences.author: Fatima & Yasir Farooqi
condolences.message: Our deepest condolences to Sr. Amina and the children. Dr. Tariq's generosity to the Bridgeview community will never be forgotten. May Allah make his grave a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
condolences.arabicDua: اللَّهُمَّ أَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ

condolences.author: Aisha El-Sayed
condolences.message: Hajja Mariam taught me my first Arabic letters 25 years ago in Paterson. She was like a mother to the entire community. May Allah elevate her rank in Jannat al-Firdaus.
